How to Protect Sensitive Skin from Peeling During Winter

During winter, skin with sensitivity can get irritated and become very dry and flaky. For this purpose, it is important to use a mild and unscented skin cleanser and always avoid the use of hot water because it causes drying of the skin by removing its natural oils.
Switch to rich creams instead of lotions and look for ingredients like ceramides, glycerine, hyaluronic acid, shea butter, and liquid paraffin to strengthen the skin barrier and lock in moisture. Don’t skip sunscreen—UV rays can still damage your skin even in winter. Dry Skin vs Dehydrated Skin – Know the Difference

Many people think dry skin and dehydrated skin are the same, but they are different. Dry skin is a skin type. It means your skin does not produce enough natural oil, so it often feels rough, itchy, and flaky. Dehydrated skin is a condition.
